report_title: CodeMix Intelligence Step 28: Statistics Schema v1.3 and Pilot Governance Finalization Report

rules.exact_one_to_one_accounting: Every token in tokens must contribute to exactly one count key.
rules.null_source_label: JSON null source labels strictly increment NULL.
rules.ambiguous_source_label: AMBIGUOUS source labels strictly increment AMBIGUOUS.
rules.provenance_isolation: MIXED and NE are never classified as OTHER. AMBIGUOUS and NULL are never classified as OTHER.
rules.total_count_equality: Total sum across all eight count keys must strictly equal len(tokens).
rules.missing_key_rejection: Missing count keys are strictly rejected; cannot be silently assumed zero.
rules.language_switch_count_policy: Considers only language-bearing classes (EN, HI, TE). Ignores OTHER, NE, MIXED, AMBIGUOUS, and null.

new_tests.name: AMBIGUOUS token counted correctly under AMBIGUOUS key
JSON null token counted under NULL key
Eight count keys sum exactly to token count
Missing count keys strictly rejected for schema v1.3.0
AMBIGUOUS strictly cannot receive any supervised class ID (0, 1, 2, 3)
NULL strictly cannot receive any supervised class ID (0, 1, 2, 3)
Language-switch count ignores AMBIGUOUS and NULL tokens

cc_by_4_accurate_scope.copying_redistribution_adaptation: Permits copying, redistribution, and adaptation, including commercial reuse.
cc_by_4_accurate_scope.mandatory_requirements: Requires proper attribution, link to license, and modification notice.
cc_by_4_accurate_scope.irrevocability: License is legally irrevocable for recipients who comply with terms.
cc_by_4_accurate_scope.prohibition_of_misleading_claims: CC BY 4.0 is not described as academic-only or non-commercial.

consent_wording_corrections.commercial_reuse_notes: If the project intends to restrict commercial reuse, that decision is marked PENDING FACULTY REVIEW; no alternative license was substituted automatically.

withdrawal_boundaries.pre_freeze_withdrawal: Permitted at any time prior to dataset freeze via pseudonymous ID notification.
withdrawal_boundaries.post_distribution_realities: Existing recipients may continue using material under license terms; project cannot promise complete removal of copies already distributed.

consent_wording_corrections.legal_status_notice: Draft consent form explicitly states it is a preliminary research draft, not legal advice or institutional approval.

participant_distribution.allocation_model: 10 examples per category are distributed across 3 qualified adult contributors where feasible (~3-4 per contributor per category).
participant_distribution.clarification: Strictly NOT 10 examples per contributor per category (which would be 120 sentences).
participant_distribution.qualification_gate: Contributors may contribute to a category only if they meet its verified proficiency requirements.
participant_distribution.identity_safeguard: Contributor IDs are pseudonyms; no real or fabricated identities exist in records.

policy.authoring_groups: Contributor IDs identify human authoring groups.
policy.corpus_groups: Document/work identifiers identify corpus source groups.
policy.zero_leakage_claim_correction: Assigning source_group_id does not automatically guarantee zero leakage; disjoint groups and sufficient group counts are strictly required.
policy.insufficient_group_handling: If independent groups are insufficient, report the limitation; never split a single group across partitions to force ratios.
policy.pilot_isolation: The 40-sentence pilot is for calibration and review testing only, not for model evaluation; pilot records are never automatically split.

safeguards_and_privacy.adult_only_safeguard: Initial pilot and collection restricted strictly to adults (>= 18 years old).
safeguards_and_privacy.pre_collection_approval: Written faculty/institutional approval strictly required before recruitment or collection.
safeguards_and_privacy.consent_storage_separation: Signed physical/electronic consent forms stored separately from pseudonymous dataset records in institutionally approved secure storage.
safeguards_and_privacy.pii_exclusion: Zero PII collected or stored in dataset files.
safeguards_and_privacy.participant_record_status: Zero participant records or real contributor details exist in this step.

reviewer_independence.stage1_review: Linguistic screening, script compliance, tokenization, initial labels by qualified fluent speaker.
reviewer_independence.stage2_review: Independent second reviewer blindly annotates raw tokens without seeing Stage 1 labels.
reviewer_independence.adjudication: Disagreements compared only after independent annotation; unresolved tokens assigned AMBIGUOUS (-100).
reviewer_independence.role_identifiers: annotator_01 and annotator_02 represent structural roles, not appointed individuals.
